name: Claude Code Dev Environment
description: Full multi-language toolchain (Python, Node, Go, Rust, Ruby, Bun, Deno) with Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, beads task manager, and host identity passthrough. Uses the pre-built ghcr.io/joeblackwaslike/devcontainer image.

containerName.description: Name for the dev container (defaults to project directory name).
